digest.component_or_area: Architecture Decision Record (ADR) system & history reclamation mechanism
propositions: ADR 0106 documentation must define a portable N-day horizon configuration key (default 30 days) with no CI-provider-specific triggers for remote-anchored history reclamation.
The ADR must specify remote-reachability computation (collapse checkpoint reachable from sync remote tickets ref >= N days) and a stale-clone forced remote-override protocol on reconnect.
The ADR must prove causal-stability invariants I1-I9 hold under reclamation and explicitly state the accepted residual: >N-day-drifted clones' divergent local work is discarded.

Signature/authorship verifiability must be preserved through SNAPSHOT authorship_ledger carriage and enforce_since re-anchor; git-ref --force-with-lease and S3 bundle-set replacement (bypassing auto-doctor per ADR 0093) are the per-backend publish-swap primitives.

The ADR-number bijection artifacts (docs/adr/.numbers/0106 marker and README.md index entry) must be regenerated via scripts/gen_adr_index.py and verified by scripts/check_adr_numbers.py and gen_adr_index.py --check in the CI docs-gates action.
docs/concurrency.md §I1 permanent retention model must be promoted from follow-up note to implemented and cross-referenced to ADR 0106.
